description: List prior OpenEvidence articles from the authenticated account. Use only when the user asks to inspect prior OpenEvidence work or needs an article_id. Inputs: limit, offset, optional search, optional include_raw=false. Returns a privacy-reduced list by default; include_raw=true may expose private prior questions and must be used only with explicit user intent. Requires authenticated session. No side effects.
name: oe_history_list
title: OpenEvidence History List
